artifact_inventory.description: Standalone symbolic check of the parameterized witness-forest exponents and monotonicity coefficients.
Deterministic output of verify_exponents.py at representative threshold values.

limitations: The correctness assessment does not promote finite symbolic checks to proof; the stronger prior theorem supplies an independent domination of the stated exponents.
record_title: Quantitative density one for distinct consecutive products
scientific_context: Quantifies Chojecki's canonical density-one construction for distinct consecutive-block products by combining the witness-forest argument with Li's 1/24 almost-all short-prime-interval theorem.
